decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already updates the mission page's prize-mechanics summary to one ticket per referral, one $500 drawing every 100 sales, Chainlink VRF selection, and increased chances from additional referrals.
The message restates that the mint number is the referral code and appears through the dashboard and confirmation email, all of which are already present in the candidate state.
The FAQ copy reflects the existing one-winner, $500, 100-sale Small Block mechanism and compatible ticket expiration rules; it does not necessarily change the mechanism's current state.
